text:
Situation: Soybean oil 20 g/100 mL is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across three sites provides 10 to 17 days on hand. Corvale East holds 58 units at 3.4 units per day (17.2 days). Corvale General holds 48.82 units at 4.3 units per day (11.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 9 units at 0.9 units per day (10.2 days). The current label identifies B. Braun Medical Inc. as the labeler with manufacturing at the B BRAUN plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show soybean oil is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is limited but not in shortage per FDA. Days on hand are low at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside. Alternative suppliers are available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation for soybean oil 20 g/100 mL; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
2. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC for soybean oil 20 g/100 mL; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory at all three sites; requires pharmacy director approval for reporting cadence.
4. Buyer to confirm allocation limits and lead times with both suppliers; requires supply chain manager approval for purchase commitments.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
